library.name: zxing-wasm (reader IIFE build)
library.description: JavaScript loader/glue for the zxing-wasm decoder — a WebAssembly build of the upstream zxing-cpp barcode library. Decodes QR codes and common 1D/2D barcodes from a device camera, on every browser the plugin targets. See amd/src/readme_moodle.txt for the local changes and for the sibling .wasm binary.

library.name: zxing-wasm (reader WebAssembly binary)
library.description: WebAssembly binary that does the actual decoding for zxing-wasm. Loaded at runtime by amd/src/zxingwasm.js via fetch(). Built from upstream zxing-cpp; the binary itself includes BSD-3-Clause code from that project under the project's umbrella Apache-2.0 distribution.
